reason: Does not fit its region in a supported build. Applied to a scratch copy: the shipping build and -Gameplay assemble, but -Define SKY_HELI=0 (decision 36's kind-cache build, build/strykers-sky_heli0.ssd, which kcguard.mjs needs) fails: game.6502:5333 "layer 1's code overruns the free block by 3 bytes" (and kindcache.6502:43's ASSERT). The unmodified source builds SKY_HELI=0 cleanly, so the candidate's +7 bytes (recounted: old 52 bytes, new 59) exceed the 4 bytes free before unused_3400_original in that build; the optimiser only checked the um_next ASSERT. Otherwise the semantics hold on the project lens: columns_to_clip_from_left (&CD = sprite_data_offset) is 0 on every unclipped entry; a clip always gives 1..12 columns (check_if_mover_is_on_screen bounds left - x by width + 1, width table max &0B, edge_x_low = viewport_left_low); &CE/&CF (screen_address) are overwritten by plot_mover_sprite before any read and the IRQ does not read them; &05/&06 (the unpacker's operand) get the same values; callers ignore Y and flags. But the build break alone refutes it.
